title: Squidward Crying
blurb: Nobody suffers as beautifully as Squidward Tentacles, and nobody suffers as loudly. His sobbing is theatrical, artistic and entirely self-aware — the crying of a man who believes his misery is being under-appreciated by an unworthy audience. That is what makes it so useful for dramatising your own smallest defeats: a Monday, a missed bus, being perceived in public before nine in the morning. Every viewer eventually stops identifying with SpongeBob and starts identifying with his neighbour, and this button simply lets you accept the transition early.
origin: Squidward's dramatic sobbing from SpongeBob SquarePants.
